source_uncertainty.statement: It is unresolved whether the P3 lower-volume/opening organization is locally compatible with a lower-sector organization directly observable inside the persisted P5 side-wall ROI.
source_uncertainty.selection_note: Persistent P3 data contains no stair, terrace or wall LocalObservation, so those cross-view candidates are not authorized. P3 does contain obs_p3_box_volume plus obs_p3_dark_opening, with CONTAINED_WITHIN acquired by 788. P5 has the persisted broad obs_p5_side_wall ROI, and 788 already established that this ROI can expose bounded lower-sector spatial structure without creating a new observation. This request therefore tests only lower-volume/opening consequences and requires NOT_OBSERVABLE if the corresponding P5 lower-sector structure cannot be reliably localized.

hypotheses_or_alternatives.meaning: The authorized visible P3 lower-volume/opening organization and a reliably localizable lower-sector organization inside the authorized P5 ROI admit the same tested qualitative constraints without a directly visible conflict. This is local compatibility only, not SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT.

At least one tested qualitative lower-volume/opening constraint has mutually exclusive directly visible states in P3 and P5, after accounting for crop/non-visibility within the authorized pixels. This is evidence against this local correspondence only.

prior_structured_memory.fact: P3 dark_opening CONTAINED_WITHIN lower_clear_volume was SUPPORTED.

P5 broad side-wall ROI yielded LEFT_OF, BELOW and BOUNDARY_JOINS constraints for its visible stair/platform sector; this authorizes inspection of bounded visible structure inside that ROI but does not create a lower-volume observation.
P4/P5 wall-sector correspondence remains AMBIGUOUS; OPENING_TO_ROOF_EDGE_RELATION=BELOW is only local compatibility. Do not repeat that discriminant.

discriminating_properties.instruction: In P3, inspect only the authorized box-volume and dark-opening ROIs. In P5, inspect only the authorized side-wall ROI and first determine whether a lower volume plus opening can be reliably localized there from visible boundaries. If so, compare whether the opening is visibly CONTAINED_WITHIN that lower volume. If the P5 lower volume/opening cannot be reliably localized, return NOT_OBSERVABLE; do not invent an observation.

Where a lower volume and its opening are directly localizable in each authorized view, inspect whether the opening lies BELOW a directly visible top boundary of that lower volume. Do not substitute the roof/eave relation tested by 790. If the lower-volume top boundary is not reliably distinguishable in either view, return NOT_OBSERVABLE.

Compare only directly visible qualitative boundary organization of the lower volume and its opening: containment, visible termination/junction, or contour relation. Use only relations exposed by authorized pixels. Similar appearance is insufficient, and absence caused by crop/non-visibility cannot establish incompatibility.

response_invariants: Inspect only authorized photos, observations and exact ROIs; do not create observations.
Do not answer SAME_PHYSICAL_OBJECT, LIKELY_SAME or DISTINCT_PHYSICAL_OBJECTS. The request tests only local qualitative organization compatibility.

P5 obs_p5_side_wall is a broad persisted ROI, not a pre-existing lower-volume observation. A lower volume/opening must be directly localizable from pixels for the relevant property; otherwise return NOT_OBSERVABLE.
CORRESPONDENCE_COMPATIBLE requires directly visible matching discriminating organization; resemblance alone is insufficient.
CORRESPONDENCE_INCOMPATIBLE requires a directly visible mutually exclusive discriminating property; non-visibility, crop difference or occlusion is insufficient.
AMBIGUOUS remains required when relevant authorized pixels permit multiple organizations or mappings.
NOT_OBSERVABLE remains required when an authorized view does not expose the tested property reliably enough to compare; it is not contradiction.
Every property_result must use exactly one requested property_token and only allowed relation tokens.
Every provenance ROI must exactly equal an authorized ROI for every observation_ref it cites, and photo_index must match that observation.
Do not reuse OPENING_TO_ROOF_EDGE_RELATION, OPENING_LAYOUT_ORDER, DISTINCTIVE_OPENING_CONFIGURATION or NEIGHBOR_BOUNDARY_ORDER from discriminant 790 as the discriminating question.
Do not infer metric geometry, camera pose, depth, hidden continuation, a common physical surface, or physical identity across P3/P5.
Do not use prior prose as pixel evidence. Prior structured memory only selects the bounded test.
